results.question: Will a late EMI affect my credit score?
results.answer: A late EMI is reported as overdue to the credit bureaus for the days it was late, even if you pay it later in the same month【KB-L-08】. If the debit fails but you pay the EMI before the lender’s retry window closes, it is not reported as overdue. [KB-L-08]
